header: # Town of Mendon -- sweep decisions applied 2026-10-22; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Mendon, '2026 Town Meeting Ballot Results' tally sheet (town-posted; hand-labeled 'UNOFFICIAL RESULTS'): Christopher Corsones, the sole printed candidate for Moderator, received 170 of 181 votes. Corroborated by the draft Town Meeting minutes, March 2, 2026, signed 'Chris Corsones, Moderator.' Minted from the unofficial tally at Walter's ruling, 2026-10-22, on the sweep report's decision items.
